svg.title: Mirror Lake, twenty past six, minus eleven
svg.desc: A small prairie railway station before dawn in winter, with one wooden platform, a single lamp, a three-sided shelter, a station building with the ticket window closed, and four people waiting with bags.

g.text: Mirror Lake, twenty past six, minus eleven
Fourteen things to find. Four of the times on the timetable are crossed out in pen.
the shelter - three sides, and the fourth is the weather
the platform - one, and 406 at Toronto Union
the timetable - four times crossed out
Marie-Claire - a suitcase, four times a year
a backpack, and a single ticket
somebody with no luggage at all
two bags, and both of them heavy
